propositions: MCP agents cannot query attestation currency without triggering a claim or transition refusal, while CLI agents have `review-plan --status` for read-only inspection
The `plan_review_status` function is exported from the library and wired to CLI but has no corresponding MCP tool registration

A new read-only MCP tool `plan_review_status` must delegate to `rebar.llm.plan_review_status` and return a `PlanReviewStatusOut` model with `ok`, `verdict`, `reason`, `verified_at_sha`, and `signed_at` fields
The tool must be registered by `register_read_tools` with `READ_ONLY` annotation and excluded from `register_write_tools`
MCP output schema coverage guard requires a canonical JSON schema at `src/rebar/schemas/plan_review_status.schema.json` and MODEL_SCHEMAS registration
